body:
# Scythe Mod

**Scythe Mod** adds powerful endgame scythes with unique combat mechanics, active abilities, special right-click skills, HUD timers, custom progression, enchantments, and dark fantasy-style gameplay for both survival and PvP.

This is not just a weapon pack. Each scythe has its own playstyle, resource loop, cooldowns, risks, and combat identity.

## Features

### Bloody Scythe

A cursed melee weapon built around pressure, sustain, and finishing marked targets.

* Inflicts **Bleeding**, a custom damage-over-time effect.
* Bleeding deals true damage and ignores normal defenses.
* Has a chance to heal the wielder through **Vampirism**.
* Can partially pierce enemy damage mitigation.
* Can use the exclusive **Spiked Blade** enchantment.
* **Right Click — Blender**
  Pulls nearby hostile targets toward you, damages them, slows them, and applies Bleeding.
* **Scythe Ability Key — Blood Harvest**
  Marks nearby enemy players for a limited time. Kill during the harvest window to gain powerful temporary buffs. Fail the harvest and you are punished with debuffs.

### Toxic Scythe

An anti-armor scythe focused on poison, durability damage, and area denial.

* Basic attacks can damage the target’s entire armor set.
* Basic attacks can apply **Poison II**.
* Can use the exclusive **Acidity** enchantment to increase armor damage from Toxic Scythe abilities.
* **Right Click — Toxic Orb**
  Launches a projectile that bursts on impact, deals armor-piercing damage, applies poison, and damages armor.
* **Scythe Ability Key — Toxic Aura**
  Creates a short-duration aura that poisons nearby enemies, damages armor over time, and can trigger extra armor-piercing damage or nausea.

### Withering Scythe

A necromantic scythe built around soul harvesting, minions, and wither pressure.

* Basic attacks can apply **Wither II**.
* Killing mobs stores souls.
* Killing players stores more souls.
* Can summon up to 6 minions by default.
* Can use the exclusive **Additional Slot** enchantment to increase the minion limit.
* Can use the exclusive **Soul Siphon** enchantment for a chance to gain extra souls.
* **Right Click — Summon Minion**
  Spends souls and durability to summon a wither-skeleton minion.
* Minions follow and defend their owner.
* Minions can regenerate by consuming durability from the owner’s scythe.
* **Shift + Right Click** dismisses your summoned minions.
* **Scythe Ability Key — Withering Aura**
  Applies Wither to nearby enemies and buffs your minions with Strength and Speed.

### Golden Scythe

A luck-based scythe focused on loot, golden marks, Piglin safety, and high-value target execution.

* Adds +1 level to **Looting** while held in either hand.
* Piglins become neutral while the Golden Scythe is held, similar to golden equipment.
* The passive Looting bonus does not stack with other Golden Scythes.
* Can mark enemies so they drop improved loot when killed.
* **Right Click — Midas Touch**
  Damages a target for 50% of its max health, with minimum and maximum damage limits. If the ability kills the target, it drops loot with additional Looting power. If the target survives, it receives a golden mark and still drops improved loot when killed later.
* **Scythe Ability Key — Golden Rain**
  Marks all enemies in a large radius. Marked enemies drop improved loot when killed.

## Scythe Combat

Scythes are designed to work as real main weapons, not only as ability tools.

* Scythes can perform sword-like sweeping attacks.
* Scythes can receive regular sword enchantments.
* Scythes remain compatible with their own unique enchantments.
* Scythe-specific enchantments are restricted to their intended scythes.

## Enchantments

The mod adds custom enchantments that expand each scythe’s identity.

### Spiked Blade

Exclusive to the **Bloody Scythe**.

* Improves the Bloody Scythe’s offensive pressure.
* Cannot be applied to other scythes.

### Additional Slot

Exclusive to the **Withering Scythe**.

* Level I: +1 minion.
* Level II: +2 minions.
* Level III: +4 minions.

### Soul Siphon

Exclusive to the **Withering Scythe**.

* Has 1 level.
* Gives a 50% chance to gain double souls from a kill.

### Acidity

Exclusive to the **Toxic Scythe**.

* Level I: +11% armor damage from Toxic Scythe abilities.
* Level II: +22% armor damage from Toxic Scythe abilities.
* Level III: +33% armor damage from Toxic Scythe abilities.

## Controls

* **Right Click** while holding a scythe: use that scythe’s special ability.
* **Scythe Ability Key** default: **R**.
* **Hold Shift** on a scythe tooltip to see detailed ability descriptions.
* **Hold Alt** while viewing the tooltip to see numeric stats.

## Progression

The mod includes custom progression built around crafting, rare materials, ability mastery, and scythe-specific challenges.

* Bloody Essence
* Toxic Essence
* Withering Essence
* Golden Essence
* Custom scythe crafting recipes
* Custom advancements for crafting, collecting materials, using abilities, summoning minions, harvesting souls, marking enemies, and mastering every scythe

Some advancements are tied to specific scythe mechanics, such as:

* Crafting scythes and essences.
* Using special and active abilities.
* Summoning and maintaining Withering Scythe minions.
* Mastering Bloody Scythe combat.
* Using Golden Scythe loot mechanics across different dimensions and days.

## Compatibility

* Includes optional **JEI** support.
* Includes English and Russian localization.
* Includes full **Combat Extended** support.

## Requirements

* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API
* A compatible Minecraft version listed on the downloaded file
